description: `new --dry-run <name>` prints the numbered plan (`_new_project_plan`: mkdir, git init, .gitignore, first commit, then add's and start's own logic) and creates nothing — `cmd_new` returns `EXIT_OK` immediately after printing it, before ever touching the filesystem or asking to proceed. Deliberately configured with no `[accounts.*]`/`[roles.*]` tables at all (`new --dry-run` never needs one to print its plan), so this is one of the few new scenarios in this batch that does not also exercise the Rust CLI's unrelated retired-role-key config-loader gap.
